cells.title: Point — symmetry order inf, singular curvature
cells.desc: unchanged under ANY rotation — cannot indicate a direction

cells.title: Circle — symmetry order inf, smooth curvature
cells.desc: unchanged under ANY rotation — cannot indicate a direction

cells.title: Line — symmetry order 2, singular curvature
cells.desc: a half-turn returns it — indicates an axis, not a sense

cells.title: Wave — symmetry order 2, smooth curvature
cells.desc: a half-turn returns it — indicates an axis, not a sense

cells.title: Angle — symmetry order 1, singular curvature
cells.desc: no non-trivial rotation returns it — indicates axis AND sense

cells.title: Curve — symmetry order 1, smooth curvature
cells.desc: no non-trivial rotation returns it — indicates axis AND sense
